# Standby Generator Guide.com
> Power When It Matters Most
> Independent, source-linked information for US homeowners researching standby generators. We are not affiliated with generator brands, dealers, or installers and do not accept their advertising, sponsorships, payments, or referral fees.

## Mission
Standby Generator Guide is an independent informational publication helping US homeowners understand standby generator sizing, equipment, installation scope, costs, and maintenance before speaking with qualified local professionals.

## Editorial method and current limits
We distinguish manufacturer specifications from manufacturer claims, estimates, and editorial interpretation. We link to source material where practical, do not claim hands-on testing or licensed review we have not performed, and update or correct material errors transparently.

No independent licensed professional has reviewed our articles. Research authorship and source citations are not professional signoff. Topic-specific editorial desk bylines are organizational labels, not individual people, electricians, engineers, installers, or product testers. Content is educational, not a substitute for exact-model manuals, qualified local professionals, permitting authorities, or a property-specific assessment.

The site provides four browser-local planning worksheets (load planning, fuel comparison, quote comparison, ownership budgeting) that calculate illustrative scenarios from user-entered or documented inputs. They do not provide an automatic sizing recommendation, installed quote, or home-specific engineering determination. Appliance wattage chart values are generic ranges published by Champion Power Equipment; they are planning references, not measurements of a particular appliance or a recommendation for a particular home.

## Core guides
- [First-Time Buyer Guide](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/guides/first-time-buyer-guide/): Questions to resolve about loads, fuel, installation scope, proposals, and ownership.
- [Generator Sizing Guide](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/sizing/what-size-generator-do-i-need/): Load-based concepts, sourced generic ranges, an illustrative example, and a static worksheet.
- [Appliance Wattage Chart](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/sizing/appliance-wattage-chart/): Generic manufacturer-published ranges; confirm the exact appliance nameplate and manual.
- [Standby Generator Cost](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/cost/standby-generator-cost/): Source-scoped equipment prices and installation estimates; not local quotes.
- [Generator Brands](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/brands/): Selected model-specific research with source dates and explicit data gaps.
- [Exact Model Library](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/models/): 32 exact standby-generator configurations with manufacturer-linked fuel ratings; missing manufacturer data stays explicitly missing.
- [Standby Generator Quote Checklist](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/cost/standby-generator-quote-checklist/): A 16-line proposal-scope checklist and side-by-side worksheet.
- [5- and 10-Year Ownership Cost](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/cost/standby-generator-ownership-cost/): Transparent long-term planning worksheet using exact-model fuel data and user-supplied local costs.
- [Installation Guide](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/installation/what-to-expect/): Project scope and questions for qualified local professionals.
- [Maintenance Checklist](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/maintenance/generator-maintenance-checklist/): Manual-first guidance separating owner checks from technician work.
- [Generator Safety](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/guides/generator-safety-overview/): Carbon-monoxide, electrical, fuel, and storm hazards with government/safety sources.

## Trust and method
- [About](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/about/): Mission, reader focus, and independence.
- [Editorial Policy](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/editorial-policy/): Source, independence, and corrections standards.
- [Professional Review Status](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/review-process/): Current absence of independent licensed review and disclosure expectations.
- [Editorial Team](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/editorial-team/): Topic-specific research desks, attribution rules, and clear limits; no individual credentials are implied.
- [Funding Disclosure](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/affiliate-disclosure/): No live advertising, affiliate links, or generator-industry payments.
- [Disclaimer](https://standbygeneratorguide.com/disclaimer/): Educational-use limits, estimates, and professional safety boundaries.

## Interpretation
Trace technical and price claims to each article's cited, dated sources. Confirm exact equipment, manufacturer instructions, local requirements, and current regulations with qualified professionals before purchase or installation. A general guide cannot determine whether a generator or installation is suitable for an individual property.
